```{r exec-pdf-setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
version <- desc::desc_get_version()
build_date <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")
gitbook_on <- FALSE

# Source the same setup chain index.Rmd uses, so every object the executive
# summary references is defined. params above set run_project and all update_*
# flags FALSE, so this reads committed caches and never touches the database.
source('scripts/packages.R')
staticimports::import()
source('scripts/staticimports.R')
source('scripts/functions.R')
source("scripts/02_reporting/0100-load-bcfishpass-data.R")
source("scripts/02_reporting/0120-read-sqlite.R")
source("scripts/02_reporting/0105-params-derived.R")
source('scripts/02_reporting/0130-tables.R')

form_edna <- tryCatch(
  readr::read_csv(
    paste0("data/backup/", params$project_year, "/form_edna_", params$project_year, ".csv"),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ),
  error = function(e) {
    message("form_edna CSV not found -- using empty stub for exec summary")
    tibble::tibble(stream_name = character())
  }
)
```
